assertions.name: the gateway refused the request, so an event was produced
the caller was given a request id to correlate with
exactly one audit fact was stored
the fact has exactly one ingest receipt
the schema identifier was stored whole
the fact is attributed to the gateway
the stored request id matches the one the caller saw
the stored envelope carries no credential material

blockedBy: the Gateway has a durable sink (HttpSecurityAuditSink) but no credential for the canonical ingest: iam-service exposes no service-token or client-credentials endpoint, audit-service validates issuer and audience on /internal/v1/audit/**, and AGENTS.md makes iam-service the only token issuer. Service-to-service authentication is an architecture boundary change and needs an ADR before it can be wired.
